shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement remain executable. In the verified active NOSTROMO loop, SHROOMING has a separate feedback-conditioned deterministic reader v0.4. Only explicit structured upstream markers can condition reading; when evidence, contradiction and question signal classes co-occur, their bounded lens priorities compose instead of one signal silently overriding the others. Ordinary lexical mentions remain auditable but cannot hijack conditioning. Conditioned rounds now also preserve bounded stance disagreement across VERIFY/CHALLENGE/HOLD_UNRESOLVED/RECONSTRUCT or PROPOSE/REFRAME roles, with no reaction receiving closure authority. The formal RUN_READING_ROUND baseline remains parent-invariant v0.9 and unchanged, preserving R111→R112→R113 reproducibility. Neither the feedback-conditioned active-loop reader nor the formal/experimental branches represent semantic learning, belief revision, ten independently persistent live LLM processes or real social emergence.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are executable. MINE_REPO allows each matching repository file to contribute a bounded number of separated query windows before deduplication, preserving path, true source occurrence ordinal, occurrence offset, query-occurrence count and source-family provenance. The verified v0.2.3 adversarial suite preserves true ordinals when nearby occurrences are skipped, retains bounded provenance for exact normalized copies suppressed from amplification, contains lexical near duplicates, and after diversity-preserving selection builds a bounded query-removed lexical co-context graph over retained hits. The query token itself is removed before affinity comparison; mapped vein members remain separate hits, cross-family veins remain audit metadata rather than evidence-independence claims, and unrelated retained material can remain explicitly unclustered. This is deterministic lexical/structural coverage and affinity mapping, not semantic clustering or conceptual vein detection, exhaustive within-file coverage, derivative-source inference, source-independence proof, source-quality scoring, novelty proof or truth judgment. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL remains limited to explicit authorized query-scoped connector sources; it does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling or cross-source enumeration. FALSIFY remains repository-scoped and absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY v1.6 computes SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INDETERMINATE over an explicit evidence bundle while suppressing exact replay amplification, preserving same-fingerprint opposite-relation integrity conflicts, optionally enforcing a caller-supplied freshness policy, and optionally enforcing a minimum authoritative source-family corroboration gate. Under an active freshness policy, only FRESH evidence may create or directionally block current certainty; stale, undated, future-dated and coarse date ranges overlapping the as-of boundary remain visible for audit. Historical authoritative disagreement outside the freshness-eligible set is preserved separately as rawAuthoritativeConflict and freshnessExcludedAuthoritativeConflict instead of automatically blocking a fresh current verdict. Same-fingerprint contradictory relations remain globally INDETERMINATE because they represent input-integrity failure rather than ordinary historical disagreement. Under the diversity gate, only explicitly caller-declared sourceFamily or publisher labels count toward corroboration; different source display names without declared family identity stay auditable but cannot manufacture independent-family certainty. It does not infer whether a claim is time-sensitive, search the web by itself, validate timestamps, prove source independence, detect derivative sources, score methodological quality, or treat absence of refutation as global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.25 is a deterministic heuristic metabolic router, with active carry rendering v1.1.12. Risk quarantine is context-gated: dedicated failure/risk paths, explicit failure status values, explicit status/result/outcome failure markers, and descendant payload atoms carrying an inherited failed/rejected/invalid/quarantine/untrusted ancestor status in provenance are quarantined before semantic routing. The verified failed-ancestor adversarial test shows that a FAILED executor bundle cannot leak sibling claim/evidence/question payloads into downstream organs as fresh successful material, while an EXECUTED control envelope remains routable even when ordinary semantic prose mentions invalid or error. It preserves nutrient atoms, routes and provenance while applying bounded carry-rendering containment for inherited substrate, intra-atom and cross-segment echoes, volatile lineage, nested clauses, repeated route metadata, delimiter collisions and exact bare true/false/null/undefined scaffolding. Machine-only hexadecimal ref/targetRef/clause/clauseRef identifiers are excluded from prose carry and preserved separately in a bounded carryRefs ledger with path, route, type and provenance. Bare scalar cleanup is carry-only: numeric evidence and substantive lexical phrases are retained, and source nutrients are not mutated. These are deterministic structural/contextual routing rules, not semantic deletion, truth judgment, semantic novelty detection, semantic identity, semantic risk understanding, source-quality judgment or proof that all metabolic echo is solved.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA retains proposition-aware dismantling, uncertainty/provenance preservation, contest persistence, multi-organ conflict-context routing, replay containment, content-bound history attestation and semantic-operator-preserving replay identity. Its branch-scoped receipt ambiguity/conflict guard is now v0.5.2: qualifying executed returns that share targetRef + clauseRef + lens are audited together even when organ labels differ. Explicit opposite lexical polarity across organs still promotes the branch to CONTESTED_BY_RECEIPTS and remains compatible with conflict escalation to DROPLET, MUTHER and SHROOMING. When at least one relation is lexically UNSPECIFIED, branch ambiguity is preserved instead. Bounded English/Chinese negation, insufficiency, explicit modality and explicit conditionality masks remain active. The new bounded English condition-prefix pass covers only-if, provided-that, assuming-that, subject-to and under-the-condition-that forms before the directional verb, without crossing sentence or semicolon boundaries; these forms therefore cannot manufacture unconditional support/refute closure merely because the directional vocabulary appears later in the same conditional clause. Conditional cross-organ returns block false closure without being mislabeled as an explicit contradiction. Same-direction unconditional controls remain resolvable. Its cross-organ provenance-diversity/content-replay guard remains v0.3.3, including comparison, equality, addition/subtraction, multiplication and division operator preservation. Distinct organ or canonical provenance labels still do not prove real-world source independence. These remain deterministic lexical/structural guards, not general semantic condition/negation/modality scope resolution, semantic adjudication, factual truth, derivative-source detection or real-world source-independence proof.
